title: XDrip does not alarm for high and low glucose levels
symptom: Alarms are set and work properly after reboot of the smartphone. After a certain time (few hours) something causes that alarms are logged and listed in the status line but neither sound nor vibration is working on the phone. In parallel the vibration alarm on my smart watch is working well.
